english.title: Fail to comply with adjudicators requirement to attend hearing or produce document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with the requirement of a notice sent by the adjudicator under paragraphs 5(1) of Schedule 1 to the Civil Enforcement of Road Traffic Contraventions (Representations and Appeals) (England) Regulations 2022

(A)_[to attend at a time and place specified in the notice to give evidence]_
(B)_[to produce documents in your custody, or under your control, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENTS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 5(1) and (7) of Schedule 1 to the Civil Enforcement of Road Traffic Contraventions (Representations and Appeals) (England) Regulations 2022.
